svg.aria-label: One warp request of 32 lanes of 4 bytes touches 4 sectors when contiguous and aligned, 5 when misaligned by 4 bytes, 8 at stride 2 and 32 for a column walk; each distinct 32-byte sector is one transaction.
svg.title: One warp request of 32 lanes of 4 bytes touches 4 sectors when contiguous and aligned, 5 when misaligned by 4 bytes, 8 at stride 2 and 32 for a column walk; each distinct 32-byte sector is one transaction.

g.text: one warp request: 32 lanes × 4 bytes, against global memory in 32-byte sectors (4 sectors = one 128-byte line)
accent: the bytes the lanes asked for · outline: the rest of the sector, moved too · one transaction per distinct sector
a column of a row-major matrix
gpusim.simt.coalescing() counts the distinct sectors; a 128-byte line holds 4 of them
